title: Ghost of Tsushima
summary: Samurai Jin defends Japan's Tsushima island from the 1274 Mongol invasion.

moments.label: Scouting the Mongol Camp
moments.detail: Jin and Yuna discuss their past and approach the camp where Taka is held.

moments.label: Finding a Way In
moments.detail: Jin and Yuna inspect the camp defenses and look for a way inside.

moments.label: An Unexpected Encounter
moments.detail: Jin and Lord Shimura track a wounded bear and discover a dead assassin.

moments.label: Rescuing the Slaves
moments.detail: Jin slips into the camp and frees the prisoners being held by Mongols.

moments.label: Lord Shimura's Captivity
moments.detail: Lord Shimura refuses to surrender to the Mongol leader despite being imprisoned.

moments.label: Hiding in the Sake Cart
moments.detail: Kenji helps Jin smuggle himself into Azumo Bay hidden in a cart of sake.

moments.label: Saving Taka from the Slaver
moments.detail: Jin confronts the slaver threatening Taka and rescues the blacksmith.

moments.label: Escaping Azumo Bay
moments.detail: Jin, Yuna, Taka, and Kenji flee the burning town and regroup safely.

moments.label: Looking for Sensei Ishikawa
moments.detail: Jin arrives in the forest and asks a villager for directions to Sensei Ishikawa's dojo.
